about_the_game:
💗Naughty Doughy Demo💗

There is more to this bakery than the scent of warm bread! Enroll three charming young ladies and turn your business endeavor into a maelstrom of experiences and emotions. Naughty doughy is a mix between visual novel and dating simulation, interspersed with a number of mini-games. This demo introduces Haruna, the first of three ladies!

A new beginning

As the corporate career that your parents had pushed you into leaves you exhausted and depressed, you make the radical decision of giving it all up. You resettle in your home town and revive the family bakery.

Reality kicks in quick - the shop does not make enough money to keep going. As you start lamenting your poor decision-making skills, luck eventually comes through the front door: a charming young lady crosses your path and take interest in your business endeavor.

A maelstrom of experiences and emotions

Haruna starts turning everything upside down. You juggle with her emotions, her aspirations and the interest she starts taking in you - all while channeling their energy to attract clients and turn your shop into a success story.

Engage with her on a variety of topics to get to know her better. Treat her with compliments and rewards to build bonding. Uncover her story and see what she is up to.

Knead those buns!

When the moment is right, take your skills from the kitchen to the bed as Haruna craves for your expert hands. This demo offers two fully animated sex scenes to unlock and revive at will.

A galore of mini-games

While the store runs, you will be offered to perform a number of small tasks here and there for chances to climb the ladder of efficiency and boost your stats.

Haruna - soft voice, bold heart

Haruna, the lady introduced in this demo, looks more shy, less self-confident than you would expect her to be with her cute face and her impressive curves. But is she really? She does know what she wants and how to get it. Learn her game, find out the motivations beyond her constant display of positive energy, and uncover the double life she's living.

Aoki and Yuna

Your progress in the demo will be carried over to the full game, which will then introduce two more ladies!

content_descriptors.notes: Naughty Doughy is a 2D animated dating adventure with frequent depictions of sexual intercourses between consenting adults. Mature content in this game includes manual, oral & vaginal sex, as well as lewd language.
